source_snapshot.criteria: Defines the maximum inlet temperature to generate a warning condition in the STATUS_TEMPERATURE command.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no "$DUT_USER@$DUT_IP"  "echo ---pmbus_names---; head -n 1 /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon*/name 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'pmbus|psu|power' || echo no_pmbus_dev; echo ---i2c_buses---; sudo i2cdetect -l 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'smbus|i2c' || echo no_i2c_tools; echo ---reg_MFR_TEMP1_MAX---; sudo i2cget -f -y ${PMBUS_BUS:?set PSU i2c bus} ${PMBUS_ADDR:?set PSU i2c addr} 0xB0 2>&1"
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: enumerate the hwmon PMBus + i2c buses on the DUT so the MFR_TEMP1_MAX register (0x0xB0, max temperature-1 factory limit) can be read; then, once the user supplies the PSU i2c bus+address, read the register with i2cget/i2ctransfer and return the FULL value. Agent returns the PMBus/i2c enumeration + the register value once bus/addr are given.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: requires the PSU to be PMBus-connected and the exact PSU i2c bus/address from the board schematic; reading a raw PMBus register needs i2c-tools on the DUT. State: read-only, but target bus/address must be verified against the board before using i2cget.

original_test_intent: Read and report the manufacturer's maximum inlet-temperature threshold used to generate the PSU STATUS_TEMPERATURE warning, with the correct sensor meaning, units and encoding.
original_method: Identify the CRPS PSU and its inlet-temperature limit definition, issue the approved read-only MFR_TEMP1_MAX transaction, retain and decode the complete value, compare it with the project/vendor threshold, and correlate read-only status context without injecting temperature.
manual_activity: The core is a deterministic threshold read and decode. An engineer supplies the vendor register definition, expected inlet limit and approval; no chamber operation, heat injection or visual observation is required by this source row.
required_inputs: PSU model/firmware and board PMBus bus/address ownership map
Vendor definition of MFR_TEMP1_MAX, including inlet sensor identity, transaction type, width, PEC, numeric encoding and units
Approved expected maximum inlet threshold and comparison tolerance/rule
Approved read-only PMBus/vendor tool and version
Authenticated access, one-user approval and bus recovery procedure
safety_requirements: Do not assume 0xB0, byte width, Linear11/Linear16, signedness, scaling, units or the TEMP1 sensor mapping.
Keep the action read-only; do not change the threshold, inject heat, manipulate STATUS_TEMPERATURE or use forced access/blind scans.
Do not clear logs; preserve pre-read context and the post-read delta.
Use authenticated transport and stop on ambiguous decoding, wrong target, bus error or PSU/BMC/host change.
Do not automatically retry with another register, access width, address, reset or power cycle.
agent_execution_scope: Verify the target, inlet-sensor mapping and resolved read-only transaction before approval.
Capture the full raw threshold response, decode temperature with units and retain tool/transport status.
Repeat the unchanged query for consistency and compare the decoded threshold with the approved value.
Collect read-only STATUS_TEMPERATURE context and preserved logs; report facts without a formal verdict.
engineer_actions: Provide the vendor mapping, expected inlet threshold and comparison rule.
Approve the target/read path and recovery procedure.
Resolve any device-specific encoding or threshold semantics.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not acceptance-ready: 0xB0 and byte-read semantics are not sourced, `-f` can bypass ownership, SSH handling is insecure, only one hwmon name is inspected, ipmitool is unused and `0x0xB0` is malformed in the narrative.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the vendor/board-approved non-forced read-only transaction through authenticated transport and decode the raw value with the documented inlet-temperature format.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Attended Time 5 and Machine Time 5 are retained. The source supplies the functional meaning but no numeric expected limit.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a versioned mapping from MFR_TEMP1_MAX to the inlet sensor and numeric format, take two unchanged approved reads, decode with units, and compare to the project threshold while preserving status/log context.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only the mapped PSU model/firmware and PMBus path.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record vendor register-map revision, PSU/BMC firmware and reader version.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project-supplied PSU vendor command/thermal documentation; the review does not assert generic 0xB0 semantics.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds traceable raw-to-temperature decoding and an explicit expected comparison without turning the definition check into a thermal-stress test.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The threshold read verifies the configured/advertised limit only; it does not prove a physical warning is asserted at that temperature.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Sensor/register map, encoding, units, expected limit, target map and approved tool.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong format can yield a plausible temperature; read-only status correlation cannot replace warning trip validation.

project_override_considerations: The project may approve a BMC API, vendor utility or direct PMBus reader if raw/decoded equivalence is documented. A project threshold may complete that approved plan, but must not be presented as a universal library value or as proof of warning activation.
expected_evidence: PSU/firmware identity, inlet-sensor definition, vendor map and tool versions
Exact read-only transaction and two full raw responses
Documented encoding, decoded temperature and units
Approved expected threshold/tolerance and explicit comparison
Read-only STATUS_TEMPERATURE context, preserved log delta and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criteria consistently describe the inlet warning threshold definition. Their omission of a numeric value and encoding is a project input gap, not a contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The requested quantity and its relationship to STATUS_TEMPERATURE are clear. Vendor mapping and expected value affect readiness, not the feasibility of the review or automated core.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Reject the unsourced 0xB0 forced byte read while preserving the need for full raw output.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agree that this is not a heat-injection test and that mapping/encoding must be supplied; reclassify from PARTIAL because the approved read/decode/compare core is fully automatable.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates deterministic threshold acquisition from engineer-supplied semantics and explicitly prevents false warning-trip coverage.

review_improvement: This record makes the inlet sensor, numeric format, units and expected comparison auditable, preserves the original definition-only scope and removes the unsupported assumption that a single forced byte at 0xB0 is sufficient.
independent_technical_reasoning: MFR_TEMP1_MAX is a static manufacturer threshold query, not an environmental stimulus. Once the authoritative mapping and expected threshold are supplied, acquisition, repeatability checking, decoding and comparison are automated; engineer input and verdict do not make it PARTIAL.

no_automatic_retry: If target, sensor mapping, response format or platform state is abnormal, preserve raw output and stop. Do not guess a new command/address/width, force the bus, write a limit, reset or power-cycle automatically.
